answer:
Promptfoo doesn't have a setting that runs providers one at a time specifically. Its concurrency control applies to all test cases and providers together. To make everything run sequentially, set the concurrency to 1:

```bash
promptfoo eval -j 1
```

or use the long form, `--max-concurrency 1`.

You can also set it in your config file. I believe it goes under `evaluateOptions`:

```yaml
evaluateOptions:
  maxConcurrency: 1
```

Check the exact option names against your installed version with `promptfoo eval --help` or the current docs, since I'm not certain of them. I also don't know of a per-provider sequencing option, so if you need providers to run in a specific order, you may need to split them into separate eval runs and invoke them one after another in a script.
